name: Men's USAF-style mess dress: officer shoulder boards (Air Force blue, overlay, blank grade)
size_basis: Same artwork box and scale as garment-mess-dress-male. Board 5.5 x 2.25 in per CAPR 39-1 Figure A5-3 (men's 5 1/2 x 2 1/4 in with button; women's 4 1/2 x 2 in); other officers boards are covered in Air Force blue material, 0.5 in blue lace each side.
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in)
documented: officers wear shoulder boards with bullion grade insignia and 1/2 in dark blue braid (paragraph text 4.1.2.1.1.1, per Ethan; the Fig A5-3 caption says 1/4 in for women) down each side, with a button at the peak (CAPR 39-1 4.1.1.1.1.1)
placed as close to the shoulder seam as possible
assumed: Air Force blue / silver lace colours sampled, not specified as RGB
grade insignia not drawn: placed at rank_slot
